label: Actual esse responsibility composes across an immediately following PER_SE_5 link
paraphrase: Open analyst reading. For every actual distinct giver a of b's esse and every actual PER_SE_5 link from b to c, a is causally responsible for c's esse in the same profile. AsCaused b c classifies the outgoing link; applying the rule to every qualifying a is substantive. The profile has no exercise-time index.
